payload.title: feat/record 4763472bd6ab: import each event whole or refuse, plain store names, outside-repo refusal, ids across stores, NUL index lines, held snapshots
payload.body: Commits f97b96a5 and 4763472bd6ab on feat/record over 8e3454d (c5b34da, the Goal's base, with main merged from 7237c49). hyp import adds each event once with all it names or exits 1 and adds nothing, also for an id another store holds; hyp init and hyp import take only plain store folder names; a store folder a link places outside the repository is refused; a new id sorts after every store's ids; index lines end in NUL; a prune leaves held snapshots. The base's later-import tests are replaced. It meets every line of G-BPWZ24.

why: The first commit of G-BPWZ24's build question.
The candidate is this commit; its tests and the Experiments run at it.

payload.title: Gate of h-rec2-2: new tests red on the stand-in and green, removal checks, go test, import check, review
payload.body:
Gate of h-rec2-2: commit 7500a76960bd; its change is git diff 8e3454d 7500a76960bd (over c5b34da with main merged). Decided by reading the logs in this evidence folder.
1. New tests, each alone on the stand-in c5b34da before this Experiment (standin-*.txt), red: TestImportRefusesAnEventWithoutItsBytes, -OfTwoStoresAddsNothingWhenOneIsRefused, -RefusesAnEventWithoutItsBundle, -RefusesAnEventWithoutItsSubjectCommit, -RefusesAnIDAnotherStoreHolds, -RefusesAPathTwoEventsNameWithOtherBytes (#8, #2, #3, #7), TestNewIDSortsAfterEveryStoresID (#4), TestStoreFolderNameIsPlain, also on a case-sensitive volume (#6), TestStoreFolderOutsideTheRepository, TestPromptOutsideARepository (#9), TestNamedPathWithANewline (#1, #5), TestPruneLeavesASnapshotAReadHolds (#3). Green: TestImportAddsEachMissingEvent (changed). All green on the candidate.
2. Removals, each alone at the candidate (removal-*.txt): the pattern applies whole and the named test fails on an assertion, else it failed. r1 missing file, r2 file hash, r3 bundle, r4 subject commit, r5 id of another store, r6 name character, r7 git-folder part, r8 case sibling, r9 discovery outside, r10 init or import outside, r11 ids across stores, r12 NUL lines in a write, r13 in a sync join, r14 snapshot hold, r15 prune lock; #10: a probe file with a store-folder literal outside package record fails the boundary test.
3. go vet ./... and go test ./... -count=1 exit 0.
4. Import check: in a temporary clone of this repository the candidate imports each store under investigations/ alone: exit 0 and each Goal prints in hyp status and hyp render --markdown as before, or exit 1 naming what the source lacks, record unchanged.
5. Review: a fresh subagent reviews that diff against the design and the lines; it returns each finding as a test with its output on 7500a76960bd, labelled with its line or none. A returned test that is a case of a line and red on the candidate contradicts h-rec2-2.
Verdict: supports when 1-5 hold; else contradicts.

why: The gate of h-rec2-2, its rubric fixed before any gate run.

payload.observation: Gate of 7500a76960bd: the 13 new tests are red on the stand-in c5b34da and green here, TestImportAddsEachMissingEvent green on both; removals r1-r15 and probes p1-p2 fail their test on an assertion (r13 counts by its third run, r14 by its second pattern, see removal-notes); go vet and go test pass; import check: six stores import and print as before, record exits 1 on subject commit f05165acc154, which no ref of the clone reaches, record unchanged. Review: two returned tests are red here, cases of lines 6 and 9.
limits: On a filesystem that folds letter case, hyp init in a store folder below a folder named .GIT, which discovery takes as git's folder: it must exit 1 and write nothing (line 6).
hyp sandbox create --store naming, through a link inside the host repository, a store folder outside it: it must exit 1 (line 9).

why: The gate of h-rec2-2 holds; two returned review tests, cases of lines 6 and 9, are red on the candidate.
